assumptions: Linear elastic, small deflection, isotropic: E 1120 MPa, a modulus across the layers (Z), and strength 20 MPa everywhere (Bambu PETG Basic TDS V2.0: E is the Z tensile modulus (X-Y 1460 MPa; the reformulated V3.0 lists 2550, not used); the strength is an allowable below the Z tensile strength (39 MPa; 35 in V3.0)), though a printed part is not isotropic. Every field scales with the load. It shows where and at what load the part first reaches its strength, not how a crack grows after that. Faces clamped where held; no contact, preload or buckling. Elements touching the clamp and load patches are left out of the failure test and capped at the design stress (their spikes are artefacts of the idealised supports). Stresses are element corner peaks, as the safety factor uses; the overstressed volume counts whole elements (an upper bound). The section cut shows the surface skin, not the stress inside.
